role: Defines the theatre every other component is scoped to.
decision: Use nyc_harbor ((-74.4, 40.48, -73.85, 40.92)) as the primary theatre, working in EPSG:32618 metres.
rationale: A drowned-river harbor city: Raritan and Upper Bay water, the Hudson and East River channels, the Palisades and Watchung rise to the west, and four dense boroughs plus the New Jersey waterfront. Chosen as a coastal-urban morphology the shipped checkpoint has never seen: relief is low (tens of metres, ~150 m at the western ridges), so terrain masking is weak and the radar horizon carries the geometry, while the urban fabric -- a very tall, very dense Lower Manhattan core inside much lower, wider-grid surroundings -- is exactly what the physics-grade urban obstacle artifact exists to represent. Inside USGS 3DEP coverage, so the DEM is public-domain 3DEP bare earth. The threat field over this AOI is randomly spawned and parameterised exactly as it is everywhere else in the project; nothing here models any real air-defence disposition, and the guardrail in docs/DATA.md applies unchanged. The AOI was accepted only after the true line-of-sight test confirmed a monotonic masking gradient with height above ground; a flat theatre would make the signature mechanic unlearnable no matter how good the policy is.

parameters.name: nyc_harbor
parameters.bounds_policy: A broad civilian coastal-urban test envelope, about 46 x 49 km, centred on the harbor rather than on any site: enough water and shoreline for coastal corridors and multi-leg recovery routing, four distinct urban morphologies (a high-rise core, a mid-rise grid, low-rise sprawl, a ridge-backed waterfront) and open water for procedurally generated threats and missions. Lower Manhattan is a high-resolution urban sub-box inside it, not the AOI. The east edge (-73.85) is placed so the box stops short of the large international airport; the south edge keeps the harbor mouth and Raritan Bay shore. It is not an airport, port or sensitive-site study: civil airfields, container terminals and restricted federal property it does contain are protected zones kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect. Bounds are fixed here and recorded in the env.aoi component; changing them changes the AOI fingerprint and invalidates every cached artifact keyed to it.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (north-east)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure. Kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect, so nothing can read as happening at an airport.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (west)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure at the box's western shore; kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: civil airport operating area (north-west)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure; kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: civil heliport (Lower Manhattan waterfront)
protected_zones.reason: Civil aviation infrastructure on the waterfront. No camera preset sits in, aims at or frames it, and no presentation effect originates there.

protected_zones.name: container port and rail terminals (west)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial infrastructure along the western shore. Kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: container port terminal (harbor south-west)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial infrastructure on the harbor's south-west shore. Kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: port and industrial waterfront (Brooklyn)
protected_zones.reason: Port and industrial waterfront. Kept clear of extracted geometry, camera framing and every presentation effect.

protected_zones.name: restricted federal property (the Narrows)
protected_zones.reason: Restricted property on both shores of the harbor entrance. Nothing here is extracted, framed, drawn or used as an effect origin; the box records only that the project stays out.

invariants: Cache keys embed the AOI bounds fingerprint; changing the box invalidates the DEM.
All env geometry is metric UTM; no per-step geodesy.
